title: Sub-Second Indexing
description: Sub-Second Indexing is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Makes events searchable within a second of arrival. Events are indexed in memory on arrival; the durable index catches up behind. It takes events and produces searchable. Tunable parameters: <1 s. Guarantee: events are never lost before indexing.

fields.mechanism: Events are indexed in memory on arrival; the durable index catches up behind.
fields.guarantees: events are never lost before indexing

demo.code:
function lag(now,event){return now-event;}
console.log('Index lag: '+lag(17,3)+' ms');

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Sliding Windows
description: Sliding Windows is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Indexes over sliding time windows for recency queries. Windows of 1m, 5m, 1h roll forward; old windows compact to disk. It takes stream and produces windows. Tunable parameters: 3 sizes. Guarantee: windows never overlap or gap.

fields.mechanism: Windows of 1m, 5m, 1h roll forward; old windows compact to disk.

demo.code:
function lag(now,event){return now-event;}
console.log('Index lag: '+lag(34,6)+' ms');

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Late-Event Handling
description: Late-Event Handling is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Accepts events that arrive late and fixes the index. Late events insert into their correct window; affected aggregates recompute. It takes late events and produces corrected index. Tunable parameters: tolerance 1 h. Guarantee: late events are never dropped.

fields.mechanism: Late events insert into their correct window; affected aggregates recompute.

demo.code:
function lag(now,event){return now-event;}
console.log('Index lag: '+lag(51,9)+' ms');

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Stream SQL
description: Stream SQL is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Queries streams with familiar SQL over windows. Queries declare windows and aggregations; the engine compiles to stream operators. It takes queries and produces results. Tunable parameters: SQL. Guarantee: queries never block the stream.

fields.mechanism: Queries declare windows and aggregations; the engine compiles to stream operators.

demo.code:
function lag(now,event){return now-event;}
console.log('Index lag: '+lag(68,12)+' ms');

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Exactly-Once Indexing
description: Exactly-Once Indexing is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Indexes each event exactly once, even with retries. Event ids dedup on write; retries are idempotent. It takes events and produces index. Tunable parameters: idempotent. Guarantee: duplicates never double-count.

fields.mechanism: Event ids dedup on write; retries are idempotent.

demo.code:
function lag(now,event){return now-event;}
console.log('Index lag: '+lag(85,15)+' ms');

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Backpressure Indexing
description: Backpressure Indexing is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Slows ingestion gracefully when the index falls behind. Lag over threshold sheds low-priority streams first; alerts fire. It takes lag and produces shed load. Tunable parameters: threshold. Guarantee: high-priority streams are never shed.

fields.mechanism: Lag over threshold sheds low-priority streams first; alerts fire.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Schema Drift
description: Schema Drift is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Handles streams whose schema changes mid-flight. New fields are added to the index; old queries keep working. It takes schema changes and produces evolved index. Tunable parameters: additive. Guarantee: drift never breaks old queries.

fields.mechanism: New fields are added to the index; old queries keep working.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Retention Tiers
description: Retention Tiers is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Keeps hot data in memory and cold data on disk. Tiers by age; queries span tiers transparently. It takes age and produces tiers. Tunable parameters: hot/cold. Guarantee: queries never see the tier boundary.

fields.mechanism: Tiers by age; queries span tiers transparently.
fields.guarantees: queries never see the tier boundary

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Join Streams
description: Join Streams is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Joins two live streams on keys within time bounds. Streams join on key with a time tolerance; late mates update the result. It takes streams and produces joined. Tunable parameters: tolerance. Guarantee: joins never emit partial silently.

fields.mechanism: Streams join on key with a time tolerance; late mates update the result.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Anomaly Queries
description: Anomaly Queries is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Finds anomalies in the stream as they happen. Statistical baselines update continuously; outliers alert. It takes stream and produces alerts. Tunable parameters: live. Guarantee: alerts always include the baseline.

fields.mechanism: Statistical baselines update continuously; outliers alert.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Replay from Log
description: Replay from Log is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Rebuilds the index by replaying the raw log. The log is the source of truth; replays rebuild any window. It takes log and produces index. Tunable parameters: full. Guarantee: replays always match the original.

fields.mechanism: The log is the source of truth; replays rebuild any window.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Partitioned Indexing
description: Partitioned Indexing is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Partitions the index by key for parallel writes. Keys hash to partitions; each partition indexes independently. It takes keys and produces partitions. Tunable parameters: hashed. Guarantee: a key always lands in one partition.

fields.mechanism: Keys hash to partitions; each partition indexes independently.
fields.guarantees: a key always lands in one partition

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Query Caching
description: Query Caching is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Caches frequent stream queries' partial results. Partial aggregates cache per window; new events update the cache. It takes queries and produces cached. Tunable parameters: per window. Guarantee: caches never serve stale windows.

fields.mechanism: Partial aggregates cache per window; new events update the cache.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Stream Lineage
description: Stream Lineage is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Tracks each indexed event back to its source. Events carry source ids; the index preserves them. It takes events and produces lineage. Tunable parameters: per event. Guarantee: lineage is never stripped.

fields.mechanism: Events carry source ids; the index preserves them.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Index Health
description: Index Health is a indexing ability in the Real-Time Stream Indexing database. Monitors the index itself — lag, errors, coverage. Health metrics per stream alert when the index degrades. It takes index and produces health. Tunable parameters: per stream. Guarantee: degraded indexes always alert.

fields.mechanism: Health metrics per stream alert when the index degrades.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.
